|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Galen's Lightsaber (V)]]. The later errata version is [[Galen's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-63-Galens_Lightsaber-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-63-Galens_Lightsaber.png]]) shows the original text; the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-64-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-galenslightsaber-pre.gif]]) show PC-E2.
* '''Original''' ([[Galen's Lightsaber (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 63; no closing full stop)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Galen. While Galen defending a battle, his and Black Leader’s immunity to attrition is +2. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, power -3, and may not be used to satisfy attrition if total destiny > defense value”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) moved “if total destiny > defense value” to the front of the sentence (with the typo “atttition” as published): “Deploy on Galen. While Galen defending a battle, his and Black Leader's immunity to atttition is +2. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > defense value, target hit, power -3, and may not be used to satisfy attrition.”<ref name="cl-1240_64-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Galen's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) has the original wording with “Juno Eclipse's” for “Black Leader's” and a closing full stop: “Deploy on Galen. While Galen defending a battle, his and Juno Eclipse’s immunity to attrition is +2. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, power -3, and may not be used to satisfy attrition if total destiny > defense value.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image prints the same text without the closing full stop (punctuation only; not a version, held for a ruling).
|hatnote=For the original printed text, see [[Galen's Lightsaber (V)]]. For the later errata text, see [[Galen's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 2)]].
